validity.researcher_notes: P7538 (Vuktyl-Ukhta Gas Pipeline, segment I, 192km/1020mm, Status=operating) is a real, well-documented Soviet-era trunk line: constructed 1967 (pipe welding), commissioned 1969, transporting gas from the Vuktyl gas-condensate field to Sosnogorsk GPZ and onward into Russia's Unified Gas Supply System. Confirmed via one independent Russian oil/gas trade-press source (nangs.org, 2021 major-overhaul completion article) plus multiple Gazprom-family documents (Gazprom Dobycha Krasnodar's own ЛПУМТ branch org-history page, a Jan-2020 Gazprom Dobycha Krasnodar press release specifically about this pipeline, and Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta's 2017 house-journal historical retrospective). No duplicate risk: this row is clearly the ORIGINAL, 1020mm, single-string 'Вуктыл — Ухта 1' line operated by Gazprom Dobycha Krasnodar -- distinct from the separate, larger 'Пунга — Вуктыл — Ухта' multi-string system (1220/1420mm class, operated by Gazprom Transgaz Yugorsk/Ukhta via the separate Vuktylskoye LPUMG branch) that shares only a place name, not an identity, with this pipeline; confirmed via the routes-repo geojson and three Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta documents describing that other system. TWO SPELLING/TYPO CORRECTIONS made per batch guidance, both same-entity standardizations, not factual disputes: (1) Operator 'Gazprom Dobycha Karsnodar LLC' -> 'Gazprom Dobycha Krasnodar LLC' (typo); (2) StartState/Province 'Republic of Komi' -> 'Komi Republic' (canonical GEM spelling, matching EndState/Province already on this row). The seemingly odd geography (a Komi-region pipeline operated by a company named for Krasnodar, ~2,500km away) is a GENUINE, well-documented administrative fact (an Oct-2014 restructuring folded the Komi-region operating branch into Gazprom Dobycha Krasnodar, which operates assets across 8 Russian regions per its own repeated corporate boilerplate) and is NOT a misattribution or copy-paste error -- confirmed across three separately-read documents. Separately, this row's routes-repo geojson contains a geometry-contamination defect (a fragment belonging to the different Пунга-Вуктыл-Ухта system) -- see the companion validity[] 'route' concern record; this does not affect the sheet's own recorded StartState/Province/EndState/Province values, both of which are correctly Komi Republic only.
